title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 84
paragraphs: Then one of the Persians, Oiobazos, made a request of Darius: since he had three sons, all serving on the expedition, could one be left behind for him? Darius said that, since he was a friend and made a reasonable request, he would leave behind all the sons. Oiobazos was greatly rejoiced, supposing his sons had been released from service; but Darius commanded those in charge of such things to put all the sons of Oiobazos to death.
